title: Report config JSON parse errors with path context
pr_title: Report config JSON parse errors with path context
pr_body:
Fixes #88.

This catches JSONDecodeError during Config.load() and re-raises a ConfigurationError that includes the config file path plus the JSON parser line and column. That keeps deployment logs actionable when a malformed config file is loaded.

Verification:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/test_config.py tests/test_config_json_errors.py -q
```

Expected targeted result: existing config tests plus the new malformed JSON regression test pass.
